newsitem.title: NORWAY: ALPINE SKIING-SUPER-G CHAMPION SKAARDAL RETIRES.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-SUPER-G CHAMPION SKAARDAL RETIRES.

text.p: Norway's Super-G Alpine skiing world champion Atle Skaardal has decided to retire because of a knee injury, the NTB news agency said on Wednesday.
The 31-year-old has had two operations on the injured knee since falling heavily in January 1992, in a race at the German resort of Garmisch-Partenkirchen.
Skaardal was crowned World Super-G Champion in Sierra Nevada, Spain, in 1996 and in Sestriere, Italy, last February.
